case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to support our operations with reliable delivery and a long relationship. Our options do exactly that for both family companies: they bring your plant a binding volume on top of what you supply us today, spread over a longer contract term.

On the price history:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On the cost side:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn the steadiest load and the longest planning horizon, and it reflects a price that has held firm for years.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this goes beyond a normal price quotation, may I ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on your side? In plain words, Option A offers your company a binding volume for the whole contract term, business in addition to today's supply, and a fair price for it. That is something your decision-maker can approve as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As the authorized representative for this negotiation, I have reviewed your proposal and the historical pricing data for the individual components. While the bundled kit is subject to current market conditions, we are prepared to support your request for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms as outlined in your Option B. In consideration of the binding volume and extended term, we can offer a revised price of €5.58 per unit for this package.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, we can provide a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.58 per unit.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for taking our price history and the volume change seriously. You said the bundled kit and a longer term are something you can support, and Option A is built for that: a binding volume on top of what you supply us today, over a longer term, for a steady load in your plant.

On the washer:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

That is why we ask you to look again at the labour and material side of the price. Here are our options:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.19; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.21; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.25; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it pairs your binding volume with a price that matches the washer history.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this may need a decision above your own desk, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides. Option A gives Leitner & Sohn a binding volume for the full contract term, business on top of what it supplies us today, with steady load for the plant and a partner who stays with it for the whole period. Could you please take Option A to that person?

We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you are keen to work together, and so are we. Option A is built on that: a binding volume that gives your plant a steady load, business on top of what you supply us today, over a longer term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.28; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.30; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.34; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant the secured volume across the full term, and it keeps the price fair for both family companies.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you may need to take this further, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides. Option A gives Leitner & Sohn a binding yearly volume over the full contract term, added to the parts we already buy from you, so your capacity is used steadily and your planning is secure. It can be approved as it stands.

Could you please take Option A to that person and let us know the outcome? We appreciate your support in this and the years of cooperation behind it.

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
